title: The person's conversation recap settings, kept in Pi's settings.json under openHabitat.recap
$comment: GET answers the stored settings, or the defaults when none are stored. PUT replaces them with the settings object and answers like GET. Errors are the common envelope: invalid_request (400), recap_settings_unavailable (503).

level.description: The scope level the person chose. The browser names the levels and their numbers; custom keeps the numbers below as the person set them.

delay_seconds.description: Quiet time before the automatic recap. Pi stops after ten idle minutes, which stops the recap timer too; the browser reports presence every 20 to 30 seconds.

model.description: The person's preferred recap model as provider/id, tried first when usable; null is the automatic choice. Never a Fable or Opus class model.

next_words.description: Length of the next-step line in words.

messages.description: How many recent person and agent messages the recap reads.

history_tokens.description: Approximate tokens of history read, stored as four bytes per token.

message_tokens.description: Approximate tokens read from one message.

response_tokens.description: The model's response limit in tokens.

first_after_turns.description: Completed turns before the first automatic recap.
